description: This is a Python source file for a conversational bot application that integrates various speech processing and natural language processing services. It sets up functions, pipelines, and event handlers for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model interactions, enabling multi-service orchestration for a WebRTC-based conversational bot.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema representing a function callable within the LLM, including its name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining a set of tools/functions available to the LLM, including standard tools like weather and restaurant recommendation.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Class for analyzing user turns locally using a smart turn strategy.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on the Silero model.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Parameters for voice activity detection, such as stop seconds.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame representing an LLM run within the pipeline.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: Frame representing a TTS spoken output.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Pipeline object chaining processing steps for the conversation.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Executor for running the defined pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a pipeline task with configuration and parameters.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring pipeline behavior such as metrics.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing conversation state and messages.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of LLM context and response processing.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for user-side aggregation, including turn strategies.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Strategies for handling user turns, including stop strategies.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy object for stopping user turn analysis.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Utility function to create transport instances based on runner arguments.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing components for the bot.
